pre_query_sequence: Storage::open RW full-retention; no benchmark metadata summary call in open path
Pass 1: skip validate_index_coverage; parse the input meta.json and read exactly query row 0 from queries.f32
Call storage.hybrid_search once for q0 (k=10, ef=200, alpha=0)
Pass 2 only: run the original validate_index_coverage before q0, matching the original reopened flow
No warm search or diagnostic_vector_metadata_summary call before q0
allowed_prequery_work: read input metadata JSON and first query vector
post_query_sequence: Only after successful q0 on pass 2, optional cyclic warm sweep (default 24; trace disabled during sweep)
note: Pass-2 coverage is the only database-wide pre-q0 scan and is explicitly retained to match the original reopen path; full metadata visibility summary and any sample queries are after q0.
